name: fillmissing
expr: fp = fillmissing(y, 'previous'); fn = fillmissing(y, 'next'); fc = fillmissing(y, 'constant', 99);
comment: Sig: y = fillmissing(x, method[, value]). MATLAB-canonical methods: 'previous', 'next', 'constant'. Numkit also supports 'mean'/'median' as convenience (undocumented). Other MATLAB methods deferred.
